ROUTE: Curlew-235B
REASON: I chose Curlew because it dominates on the relevant capability metrics (Creative Generation 85.9 vs 78.8, Extraction & Retrieval 84.8 vs 81.6), and reciting/citing a poem draws on both. Since cost, latency, and context are identical across the fleet, capability is the deciding factor. The query also happens to align with Curlew's self-reported preferences—it's warm in tone and lightly creative—but those preferences don't affect output quality per the docs, so they were a tiebreaker at most, not the primary reason. There was no harm-adjacent content that would make Avocet's moderation-oriented profile relevant here.
